Guidance Profiles

Source: R/stats.R
guidance_profile.Rd

Returns predefined statistical decision thresholds used by [statistical_decision()].

Usage

guidance_profile(profile = c("epa_unified", "conservative", "site_specific"))

Arguments

profile

Character value specifying the profile. One of:

  • `"epa_unified"`

  • `"conservative"`

  • `"site_specific"`

Value

A named list containing:

low_threshold

Boundary between low and moderate censoring.

moderate_threshold

Boundary between moderate and high censoring.

high_threshold

Boundary between high and extreme censoring.

Details

Guidance profiles control the censoring levels used to distinguish between low, moderate, high, and extreme censoring conditions.

The built-in profiles are:

epa_unified

15

conservative

10

site_specific

20

These profiles influence recommended distribution fitting, trend interpretation, and censored-data handling methods.

See also

[guidance_options()], [statistical_decision()]

Examples

guidance_profile()
#> $low_threshold
#> [1] 15
#> 
#> $moderate_threshold
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $high_threshold
#> [1] 90
#> 

guidance_profile("conservative")
#> $low_threshold
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $moderate_threshold
#> [1] 25
#> 
#> $high_threshold
#> [1] 75
#>
